prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Control Interactive Mascot Walkthrough Screen: Adds a new interactive desktop control guide screen before final completion where users can test hiding, spawning, and dragging their pet on the desktop. (why: 31.3% drop-off at the finish step and multiple support tickets regarding confusion on how to control or find their pet on the desktop.)
1: [home, redesign] Full Bleed Live Desktop Environment Waiting Hub: Redesigns the waiting screen into a full-bleed live desktop status hub that displays real-time companion rendering steps. (why: The waiting screen has a mean duration of 2336s and 3 support emails reported pets not rendering or showing up properly.)
2: [choose_path, hint] Story Screen Decision Time Nudge Hint: Displays an explicit hint on the story screen reassuring users that path selection can be changed anytime. (why: The choose_path step has a median time of 8s but a mean time of 514s, indicating long tail abandonment or indecision.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Account Recovery Reassurance Sign-In Hint: Adds a hint on the sign_in screen guaranteeing previous pet progress protection. (why: Users reported losing existing pets upon signing in with alternate email accounts.)
4: [home, notification] Desktop Readiness Sound & Status Notification: Enables sound chime and notification setting on the waiting screen when the companion is ready to appear. (why: Waiting step mean time is over 38 minutes (2336s), causing users to step away from their computer.)
5: [finish, layout] Stage Layout Desktop Companion Launch Hub: Updates the home_intro screen layout to stage view featuring explicit control shortcut cards. (why: 31.3% drop off before completing finish step, alongside support confusion on controlling the pet.)
